messages:
maria: Hey team — proposal for a small deploy workflow improvement: add a 'pin-and-announce' deploy-bot command + a lightweight release-notes template so we don't rely on manual copy/paste at end of day. Quick sketch below, looking for 👍 or :thinking_face: and any concerns about rollback ergonomics.

kevin: +1. Could you list the exact flags you want? we should avoid making the bot do anything that bypasses safety gates.

maria: Sure. Idea is two commands: 
1) `/boltbot pin-release --service <service> --version <sha|tag> --window <UTC-range> --owner @me --notes "short summary"`
2) `/boltbot announce-release --service <service> --version <tag> --notes-file <url or id>`

The pin command sets a temporary version pin in rollout config and posts a pinned message to #deploys with a checklist. announce-release posts a templated release note to #prod-release and triggers optional email digest.

anya: Love the separation. For pin, add `--mutable=false|true` so we can mark hotfix pins as non-auto-rollout. Also add `--rollback-policy=auto|manual` default manual.

maria: good call. New example snippet: 
```
/boltbot pin-release --service checkout --version v2026-03-19-abc123 --window 2026-03-20T03:00Z/2026-03-20T04:00Z --owner @maria --notes "fix duplicate charge bug" --mutable=false --rollback-policy=manual
```

jordan: Few UX questions: who can run this? should it be team-admins only? and how do we surface pin expirations (reminders)?

kevin: I'd restrict to oncall + release-approvers group. Bot can create a calendar reminder or create a follow-up thread at expiry. Also include a `--expires-in` flag as shorthand.

maria: Agreed. Proposed primary controls: allowed_roles: [release-approver, oncall, infra-admin]. Bot verifies role via SSO groups. If expiration not set, default 24h.

anya: For release notes template, can we standardize fields so observability can attach checks? Template: short summary, impacted services, config changes, rollout window, rollback instructions, test checklist, dashboard links. 

maria: Yes. Sample `announce-release` payload: 
```
/boltbot announce-release --service checkout --version v2026-03-19-abc123 --notes-file https://docs/release-notes/12345
```
Bot would expand notes using template: 
- Summary: ...
- Affected routes: ...
- Rollout plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% (30m steps)
- Rollback: `/boltbot rollback --service checkout --to-version v2026-03-18-def456 --reason "regression"`
- Monitoring: link to grafana + synthetics checklist
```

jordan: What about safety windows? we should allow `--change-window` to gate non-emergency pins. e.g. `--change-window=0900-1700` in team's timezone. Bot should reject non-emergency outside window unless `--force` with two approvals.

kevin: Good. Also include a dry-run flag so the bot posts the checklist but doesn't apply the pin. Useful for rehearsals: `--dry-run`

maria: Implementation notes for eng-releases: 
- CLI handler in deploy-bot will call releases-service API: POST /pins with auth + policy checks.
- Bot posts a canonical checklist message to #deploys and pins it. Message includes reaction shortcuts: :small_green_circle: for approvals, :warning: for concerns.
- When rollback-policy=auto and monitor triggers an alert, bot auto-executes rollback command and posts incident stub.

devops comment (sre-bot): deploy-bot->verified: role check OK; scheduling reminder set for 24h; pinned message id=R-2026-03-19-0001

anya: Nice. A couple of edge cases: multi-service deploys (allow comma list) and templated notes linking to change window in calendar. Also ensure the bot can attach the short release notes to the ticket (Jira) via `--ticket=KEY-123`

maria: I'll draft a tiny RFC and a PR for the bot changes. Will include a minimal template and a set of unit tests for permission checks + expiry behavior. Plan: land bot command + dry-run, iterate on `--rollback-policy=auto` after a short experiment.

kevin: Sounds good. For rollout safety, can we add a `--watch` param that auto-scales back if error-rate > X within Y minutes? not full AIOps but simple thresholds.

maria: yes, `--watch=\"5m:err>1%:rollback\"` style. We'll keep it optional and experimental.

jordan: LGTM. I can help with the release-notes template and Grafana links.

maria: Thanks. I'll post the RFC link here when ready. If no objections by EOD I'll open the PR for the bot handler. :thumbsup:

kevin: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Action logged: pin-release request template created. Use `/boltbot help pin-release` for usage.

maria: (follow-up) RFC: https://rdrw.internal/rfcs/2026/deploy-bot-pin-and-announce — short draft, includes API contract and sample messages. Please leave comments in the doc.

anya: Commented: added note about audit log entries and KMS key reference for private deployments.

kevin: will review PR tomorrow AM.

sre-bot: Reminder scheduled: review pin expiry for v2026-03-19-abc123 at 2026-03-20T04:00Z.
